citations.assessment: The exact name and Rav Pappi’s house introduce the Sabbath vow ruling in Nedarim.
The Shabbat passage likewise gives the Sabbath-vow ruling, and brackets Rav in this occurrence. The question about marriage is elsewhere.
The repeated Shabbat citation has Rav unbracketed.
Both the marriage question and Rav Zuti’s supporting baraita are directly present in this Yevamot segment.
The direct Rashi indeed calls the questioner Rabbi Abba Zuti. This does not identify him as Rav Zuti of Rav Pappi’s house.
The checked Bavli likewise gives Rabbi Abba Zuti in this distinct offering question.
The Abba Zuti entry records an alternative Rava Zuti form in Heilprin’s comparison.
The resh entry explicitly sends the reader back to this separate Rav Zuti question.
